tracks.title: The Falling Tile (E01-S26 + S26A, to picture)
tracks.tone: a trap closing without a tune, a click that takes every sound away, then one felt piano in the dark -- and the Orb rewinding his settle
tracks.key: F pedal with semitone-shifting clusters; Step Four (Bbm - Ab - Gbmaj7) over F; 26A F open fifth, no third

tracks.title: His Version
tracks.tone: his flattering account: a keynote-reel piano, too clean, too still, in Db major -- and cut mid-note
tracks.key: Db major / lydian: Dbmaj9(#11) | Ab/C | Gbmaj7(#11) | Db/Ab

tracks.title: The More You Buy (Nesnej)
tracks.tone: a sales pitch that climbs a step every bar and always closes: double-time swing, vibes and a straight mute over a walking bass, the chip as the GPU clock -- and a rest where the register rings
tracks.key: F dorian / F minor blues, C7#9(b13); the close on an F-C open fifth (no third)

tracks.title: Beeper, 1993 / Sample-Chip, 2008
tracks.tone: his past as the machine heard it: a 1-bit kid poking a beeper, then a 16-bit jazz trio remembering the early web -- a memory, not a video game
tracks.key: F minor (1-bit); A-flat-major colours Abmaj9 - Dbmaj9 - Fm9 - Eb9sus4 (16-bit); Fm(add9) (render front)

tracks.title: The Board's Side / What They Didn't Know
tracks.tone: their side, played straight and with dignity: a procedure that keeps going and a fourth step that is always blank; then the door back
tracks.key: B-flat minor centre (Step Four); D-flat lydian (Alyi); B-flat minor (Mario); Abmaj9 -> Cmaj9 (Tasya); F(add9) no third (09x)

tracks.key: F minor -> Bb minor (Step Four) -> F minor -> C7(#9b13) pedal, unresolved (the card's freeze hit is on F)

tracks.title: The Return (album edit)
tracks.tone: the other side's sounds hand him back his company one by one; the win scored straight and one size too big, then undercut; his felt returns last
tracks.key: Db (the Door) -> Ab/C/E mediants (the floor) -> F pedal -> C pedal -> F minor (the Build) -> Abmaj9 (the stab) -> F, open fifth

tracks.title: Outside Intended Scope: GLYPH hits, Q* and THE COPY (kit)
tracks.tone: the machine's punctuation: twelve polite dread blinks, the vault's swell, and Mas's own tune played back to him a little closer each episode
tracks.key: F pedal + the Ache; the COPY in F minor

tracks.title: Outside Intended Scope
tracks.tone: the machine learning the show's tune, politely: grains, then the knee scrambled, then almost, then running past its own ending -- dread without a single evil sound
tracks.key: F pedal + the Ache (G, Db); tokens {F G Ab C Db} (+ Eb in the runaway), F4-Db6

tracks.title: Renamed It. / The Fountain Pen
tracks.tone: state occasions at equal weight: a fountain-pen quartet signing, and a brass podium one size too big that renames the world under a held note
tracks.key: Bb major (NEDIB); Eb minor (FEAR); Eb major (LOVE) -> B/D# -> G/B (the Renames)
